title: Ensure 'Network access: Allow anonymous SID/Name translation' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Allow anonymous SID/Name translation to 'Disabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts to 'Enabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to 'Enabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Do not allow storage of passwords and credentials for network authentication' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Do not allow storage of passwords and credentials for network authentication to 'Enabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Let Everyone permissions apply to anonymous users' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Let Everyone permissions apply to anonymous users to 'Disabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Named Pipes that can be accessed anonymously' is configured
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Named Pipes that can be accessed anonymously to 'None' or 'BROWSER' (if Computer Browser service is required)

title: Ensure 'Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths' is configured
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths to the authorized paths.

title: Ensure 'Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths and sub-paths' is configured
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths and sub-paths to the authorized list (plus CertSvc or WINS if applicable).

title: Ensure 'Network access: Restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares to 'Enabled'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Shares that can be accessed anonymously' is set to 'None'

title: Ensure 'Network access: Sharing and security model for local accounts' is set to 'Classic - local users authenticate as themselves'
